field.label: Enable block page
field.help: Serve a simple page explaining that the requested site has been blocked. Blocklists without an explicit destination address will resolve blocked domains to the address below. Only plain HTTP requests can show this page, connections to HTTPS sites will fail with a browser error.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: Dedicated IPv4 address on this firewall to serve the block page on (ports 80 and 443), for example a virtual IP. Do not use an address used by the web GUI or other services listening on these ports.
